overwrites.comment: Without this, adding a method in your mixin class that has the same name as an existing method would act as an implicit @Overwrite. https://github.com/jaredlll08/MultiLoader-Template/issues/117

injectors.comment: This forces each injection to have to succeed at least once. Override at each injector using require=. Default is 0=silent fail if no hits. Here its 1=crash if a mixin fails. You can also use allow= to set a max of successes per injection.
